## Starbucks to Participate in the Bernstein 42nd Annual Strategic Decisions Conference


05/21/2026


Download (opens in new window)


SEATTLE--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Starbucks Corporation (NASDAQ: SBUX) today announced that Brian Niccol, chairman and chief executive officer, and Cathy Smith, evp, chief financial officer, will host a fireside chat at the Bernstein 42nd Annual Strategic Decisions Conference on Thursday, May 28th, 2026, at 11:00 a.m. Eastern Time.


The fireside chat will be webcast live from the company’s Investor Relations website at[https://investor.starbucks.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestor.starbucks.com&esheet=54537037&newsitemid=20260521617053&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Finvestor.starbucks.com&index=1&md5=bc0a1c4a87c19a4f3ddc041a7f8d251a) on the Events & Presentations page.


**About Starbucks**


Since 1971, Starbucks Coffee Company has been committed to responsibly sourcing and roasting high-quality *arabica* coffee. Today, with a global footprint of more than 41,000 company-operated and licensed coffeehouses and a growing presence in consumer-packaged goods, we are the world's premier purveyor of specialty coffee. Through our unwavering commitment to excellence and our guiding principles, we bring the unique *Starbucks Experience* to life for every customer through every cup. To share in the experience, please visit us in our stores or online at[about.starbucks.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fabout.starbucks.com%2F&esheet=54537037&newsitemid=20260521617053&lan=en-US&anchor=about.starbucks.com&index=2&md5=6cbe797055d709593f274858bb6abe7d) or[www.starbucks.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.starbucks.com&esheet=54537037&newsitemid=20260521617053&lan=en-US&anchor=www.starbucks.com&index=3&md5=b20800a59adf4ba30edc4a430a93c73b) .
